Northeast wind 15 to 25 knots becoming northeast 15 to 25 knots with gusts to around 30 knots in the late morning and early afternoon, then rising to up to 30 knots with gusts to around 35 knots late in the afternoon. Chance of showers in the morning. Waves 4 to 6 feet building to 7 to 9 feet.
